body.p: Claims 1-20 are pending in this application.
The Office Action requires the Applicant to elect one of the following Inventions:
I. Claims 1-15, drawn to an apparatus, classified in A61B5/165.
II. Claims 16-20, drawn to a method, classified in G16H50/30.
In response to the Restriction Requirement, Applicant hereby elects Group I comprising claims
1-15 without traverse. Claims 16-20, to non-elected Group II, are hereby withdrawn.
The Examiner is invited to telephone the undersigned, Applicant's Attorney of Record, to facilitate advancement of the present application.
